definition: Selmer Bringsjord (born November 24, 1958) is a professor of computer science and cognitive science and a former chair of the Department of Cognitive Science at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute.
details: He also holds an appointment in the Lally School of Management & Technology and teaches artificial Intelligence (AI), formal logic, human and machine reasoning, and philosophy of AI.
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. A small key that opens a much bigger door. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. And that idea, made concrete, is Selmer Bringsjord.
